## Preparing a plain text file

```{r}
library(trickypdf)
```

```{r}
doc <- system.file(package = "trickypdf", "extdata", "pdf", "UN_GeneralAssembly_2016.pdf")
UN <- trickypdf::PDF$new(filename_pdf = doc)
if (interactive()) UN$show_pdf()
```


```{r}
UN$add_box(page = 1, box = c(top = 380, height = 250, left = 52, width = 255))
UN$add_box(page = 1, box = c(top = 232, height = 400, left = 303, width = 255), replace = FALSE)
UN$add_box(page = 2, box = c(top = 80, height = 595, left = 52, width = 255))
UN$add_box(page = 2, box = c(top = 80, height = 595, left = 303, width = 255), replace = FALSE)
UN$get_text_from_boxes(paragraphs = TRUE)
plaintext <- unname(unlist(UN$pages))
```

```{r}
undoc_tmp <- tempfile()
writeLines(text = plaintext, con = undoc_tmp)
```

## From Plain text to XML (TEI standard)

```{r}
library(frappp)
```

```{r}
UNVR <- PlenaryProtocol$new(sourceDir = dirname(undoc_tmp), filename = basename(undoc_tmp))
```

```{r}
UNVR$preprocessing() # remove leading and and trailing spaces
UNVR$getMetadata() # returns a list with sessionNo, lp, date
UNVR$metadata <- list(sessionNo = "1", lp = "1", data = "")
# UNVR$getDebate()


speakerRegexGA <- list(
  pres = c(regex = "^(The\\s+President):\\s*(.*)$", who = "\\1"),
  sg = c(regex = "^(The\\sSecretary-General):\\s*(.*?)$", who = "\\1")
)
UNVR$speakerRegex <- speakerRegexGA

UNVR$speakerMismatch <- character()

UNVR$speakerFactory <- list(
  
  pres = function(x) list(
    who = gsub(speakerRegexGA[["pres"]]["regex"], "\\1", x, perl = TRUE),
    parliamentary_group = "NA",
    role = "presidency",
    position = gsub(speakerRegexGA[["pres"]]["regex"], "Presidency", x, perl = TRUE),
    text = gsub(speakerRegexGA[["pres"]]["regex"], "\\2", x, perl = TRUE)
  ),
  
  sg = function(x) list(
    who = gsub(speakerRegexGA[["sg"]]["regex"], "\\1", x, perl = TRUE),
    parliamentary_group = "NA",
    role = "sg",
    position="sg",
    text = gsub(speakerRegexGA[["sg"]]["regex"], "\\2", x, perl = TRUE)
  )
  
)




UNVR$splitBySpeakers()
```



```{r}
# self$concatenateMultilineInterjections() # in package ctk.plpr
UNVR$concatenateParagraphs(exclude = "pres")
UNVR$makeSpeakerNodes()
UNVR$makeAgendaItemNodes()
UNVR$metadataToTei()
UNVR$makeXML()

tempfile_xml <- tempfile()
writeLines(text = UNVR$xml, con = tempfile_xml)
browseURL(url = tempfile_xml)
```
